groups.title: Role and runtime boundary

invariants.spec: Installed Herdr Agent Skill is the only generic pane and agent-operation contract.
Role profiles preserve Lead, Peer, and Supervisor authority boundaries without claiming technical ACLs.

groups.scenario: Check role routing, no generic runtime wrapper, task-text preservation contract, and explicit Supervisor attachment context.

groups.title: Assignment, ownership, and candidate contract

invariants.spec: Assignment explicitly carries role, parent, owner, disposition, recipe, language, and topology rationale.
A supplied active Lead delegation map rejects overlapping write scopes without claiming cross-Lead atomicity.
Concurrent writers carry distinct project roots and use Herdr worktree allocation; single writers and read-only Peers are not forced into extra worktrees.
Review binds an exact Git candidate and completion requires a matching semantic handback with readable evidence.
An immutable Git candidate, candidate-bound evidence, conditional review, and one bounded same-Lead recovery gate human-facing completion.

groups.scenario: Validate bounded data contracts and the final mechanical acceptance gate without a registry, journal, daemon, plugin, or Herdr control wrapper.

groups.title: Project and context policy

invariants.spec: Project validation binds configured recipes and language policy at canonical project paths.
Context measurement contains no retired pack or delivery transport route.

groups.scenario: Validate project policy and ensure the helper exposes no run, pack, deliver, receipt, or lifecycle commands.

groups.title: Native launch and active collection dogfood

invariants.spec: Launcher uses official Herdr pane split, exact configured start, direct safe prompt submission, and preserves focus/topology ownership.
An active Lead waits, reads, and inspects; only matching structured handback proves Assignment completion, and detached wake is not claimed.
Literal task text is delivered without shell evaluation or semantic trimming.
The deterministic Assignment renderer preserves the exact Assignment objective, bounded scope, exclusions, authority, disposition, language, and assignment_id in its rendered Peer instruction.
A live grader binds an observed real Peer to an inspected Assignment path/hash/owner and matching structured handback without claiming the exact prompt bytes received.
A real Peer independently challenges an invalid premise with evidence-backed REOPEN_REQUEST and does not gratuitously reopen a valid premise.
A settled lifecycle state or old turn never proves completion of a newer prompt or Assignment, and timeout does not blindly resend.

groups.scenario: Run on one supported agent kind; record pane IDs, no-focus result, start state, prompt/read evidence, handback, and cleanup only for the newly-owned pane.

groups.title: Supervisor and topology dogfood

invariants.spec: Human-attached Supervisor routes bounded evidence-backed attention to its explicitly attached Lead without Lead or Peer wake responsibility.
After intervening work and handbacks, an active Lead still rejects or reconciles overlapping write scope.
Approval-gated capability is tested under a compatible configured recipe policy before launch.
A multi-scope request records coupling, dependency, and topology rationale, contrasting independent scopes with a tightly coupled bounded scope.

groups.scenario: Record governance attachment context, bounded Supervisor question, Lead response, topology rationale, ownership reconciliation, and provider approval-policy behavior without a wake bridge, router, plugin, or shared state service.

groups.title: Repeatable live-eval regression suite

invariants.spec: Each repetition materializes the skill and release-matched official Herdr skill in a fresh consumer project and isolated user scope.

groups.scenario: Use tests/evals/orchestration-evals.json and scripts/run_evals.py to exercise real supported agents with explicit per-invariant graders and repetitions. Results are bounded ephemeral evidence, not runtime state.
